steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The three Punic Wars (264-146 BC) were fought between Rome and Carthage for control of the Western Mediterranean | Key Fact: First Punic War (264-241 BC): Rome built its first navy and won Sicily as its first province | Key Fact: Second Punic War (218-201 BC): Hannibal crossed the Alps with elephants, won at Cannae (216 BC) but was eventually defeated by Scipio at Zama (202 BC) | Key Fact: The Battle of Cannae was Rome's worst military defeat: perhaps 50,000-70,000 Romans died in a single day

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the punic wars &amp; hannibal, and one past-paper question.
